name: Hadamard matrix conjecture
question: Does a real Hadamard matrix exist for every positive order divisible by four?
dispatch_next: Import one published quadruple for the smallest remaining engine gap above 172. Order 668 is still the smallest order with no known Hadamard matrix; do not search for it.
dispatch_why: Orders 116, 156 and 172 are engine gaps. The literature already constructs them. They are not the open case, which the probe frontier places at order 668.

campaign.method: Algebraic constructions (Sylvester, Paley, Williamson, propus) with exact orthogonality certificates
campaign.hypothesis: A Hadamard matrix exists for every order divisible by 4.
campaign.first_proof_obligation: Name the smallest order 4k > 172 that this engine still does not build, and import one published quadruple for it.
campaign.next_experiment: Import one published quadruple for the smallest remaining engine gap above 172. Order 668 is still the smallest order with no known Hadamard matrix; do not search for it.
campaign.falsification: A proof that no Hadamard matrix of some order 4k exists; a finite search failure is not sufficient.
campaign.blocker: Every order 4k <= 172 is now an explicit matrix. The common-multiplier Williamson search at n = 29 is a proved dead end, and order 668 remains the smallest open case.

probes.name: Hadamard matrix conjecture
probes.title: Exact Hadamard matrices from Sylvester, Paley I/II and Kronecker products
probes.frontier: Known: constructions exist for every order 4k < 668; 668 is the smallest order with no known Hadamard matrix (after order 428, Kharaghani & Tayfeh-Rezaie 2005). Orders 116, 156 and 172 are published propus quadruples (arXiv:1503.04226, arXiv:1708.05098), not new matrices. Engine gaps below are NOT open cases.

smoke.scope: Explicit (+1/-1) matrices with H H^T = nI for 32 of the 32 orders 4k <= 128 (the rest are engine gaps, not open cases).

deep.scope: Explicit (+1/-1) matrices with H H^T = nI for 91 of the 100 orders 4k <= 400 (the rest are engine gaps, not open cases).

milestones.title: Exact Hadamard matrices for every order 4k <= 172, including 116, 156 and 172
milestones.scope: Known constructions; not a new matrix and not a proof that every multiple of 4 works
milestones.description: Sylvester, Paley I/II, Williamson n=23 (order 92), and published propus quadruples for orders 116, 156 and 172, closed under Kronecker products. Each matrix is checked as H H^T = nI. Smoke covers all 32 orders 4k <= 128. Deep covers 91 of the 100 orders 4k <= 400; the first remaining engine gap is 188. Order 668 is still the smallest open case.

formal_statement.encodes: For every k ≥ 1 an Int matrix of order 4k with ±1 entries and pairwise orthogonal rows.

kernel_checked.claim: Explicit Hadamard matrices of orders 4, 8 (Sylvester) and 12 (Paley), re-checked by the kernel (order_4, order_8, order_12).
